target_customer: Consumers who track sleep with a wearable and want advice
problem: Sleep trackers show data but not how daily habits and mood affect sleep. Hypnos paired journal entries with tracker data to give insights.
product_category: AI sleep journal and coach app

founders.name: James Sinka
founders.background_notes: YC page bio: founder of Reactorfield, co-founded a biotech incubator and Orange DAO. These are later activities and the YC page gives no education or employers.

founders.name: Andrew Fleischer
founders.background_notes: YC page bio: chemist, researcher and data scientist who worked on fuel cell membranes and indoor solar technology.

exit.reason: No shutdown statement found. YC and Dealroom mark the company inactive or closed.

technical_complexity.rationale: Journal entries joined with wearable data and simple correlation insights; standard mobile app work.

defensibility.rationale: Any sleep app or wearable maker could add habit journaling; no proprietary data or integration lock in is described.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Wearable vendors added sleep coaching to their own apps over time; no source shows a specific action against Hypnos.

market_need_then: Consumer sleep tracking was an established category by 2019 with many apps and wearables; demand for insight beyond raw data is asserted by the YC pitch but no spend or user data was found.

branding.domain_note: Used hypnos.ai; no acquisition story found.

brand_strength.rationale: The name evokes the Greek god of sleep, an inference not stated by any source, and it is shared with a mattress maker and other sleep products; no press about the brand was found.

outcome_analysis: Hypnos was a small consumer sleep journal startup that took YC Winter 2019 and is now inactive. The cause is not public, funding beyond a roughly 150K seed in one database is unknown, and no traction numbers were found. No factors are assigned because no source explains why it stopped.
notes: Seed amount rests on a single database (Dealroom, which also lists two seed rounds of 125K and 150K and says founded 2020 in San Francisco); Persana reports an undisclosed seed in April 2019. Founders conflict across directories (Alberto Scicali appears in Dealroom); only the two named on the opened YC page are listed. The company website returned 503 and the Medium launch post returned 403. No competitor source dated near 2019 was found.
